description: A permanent, independently verifiable receipt anchoring an AT Protocol record to Arweave permanence and a Hive custom_json ledger entry. Schema is CC0-1.0; see LICENSE-CC0 alongside this file.

main.description: Binds one atproto record to its content hash and its external anchors. A receipt carrying anchors but no atproto record is complete and verifiable on its own.

subject.description: Strong reference (uri + cid) to the exact version of the record being receipted.

contentCid.description: CIDv1 (dag-cbor 0x71, sha-256 0x12) over the canonical DAG-CBOR encoding of the subject record. MUST equal subject.cid; a verifier MUST reject a receipt where they differ.

arweave.description: Arweave anchor holding the exact receipted bytes. Optional: omitted until settled.

hive.description: Hive custom_json anchor. Optional: omitted until broadcast.

autonomi.description: Autonomi anchor. Optional. Added in v0.2.

media.description: Content-address pointers for every blob referenced by the subject record.

createdAt.description: When this receipt was created. RFC 3339, uppercase T, timezone REQUIRED, 'Z' preferred.

txId.description: Arweave transaction or ANS-104 DataItem id. 43-character Base64URL.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the anchored bytes, lowercase hex. Makes the anchored content verifiable independent of gateway behaviour. Optional. Added in v0.2.

byteLength.description: Byte length of the anchored payload. Lets a verifier detect a truncated fetch before hashing. Optional. Added in v0.2.

bundled.description: True if this is an ANS-104 DataItem inside a bundle rather than a base-layer transaction.

settledAt.description: When the transaction was observed mined. Advisory only; not a consensus fact.

account.description: Hive account that broadcast the anchor.

customJsonId.description: The custom_json id namespace. For this spec: 'bnr.anchor'. Ceiling confirmed from live chain config: HIVE_CUSTOM_OP_ID_MAX_LENGTH = 32.

byteLength.description: Byte length of the custom_json payload. Ceiling confirmed from live chain config: HIVE_CUSTOM_OP_DATA_MAX_LENGTH = 8192. Optional. Added in v0.2.

autonomiAnchor.description: Added in v0.2. Mirrors #arweaveAnchor for the Autonomi rail.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the anchored bytes, lowercase hex.

byteLength.description: Byte length of the anchored payload.

scheme.description: Permanence rail. 'ar' = Arweave TXID. 'ant' = Autonomi DataMap address.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the blob bytes, lowercase hex. Lets a verifier confirm the fetched blob without trusting the rail. A pointer omitting this is unverifiable, and an implementation MAY refuse it rather than skip verification.

byteLength.description: Byte length of the blob. Lets a verifier detect a truncated fetch before hashing. Optional. Added in v0.2.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the blob, advisory.

sourceBlobCid.description: The blob's CID in the subject's PDS, if it originated there.
